Metadata.title: Samuel's Personal Portal · AI Chat
Metadata.description: Explore Samuel's personal portal through AI conversation, discover publicly shared content, and check the sources behind each answer.

Chat.confirmClearAria: Confirm clearing and start a new chat

Welcome.title: No page-hopping. Just ask.
Welcome.description: This is Samuel's personal portal, presented through conversation. Ask about the content shared here; I'll organize the answer and show its sources.

portal.title: Meet the portal
portal.description: Learn what this is and what Samuel shares
portal.prompt: Please introduce this personal portal: what is it, and what content is currently shared here?

topics.title: Explore public content
topics.description: Start with a topic that interests you
topics.prompt: What topics and content in this personal portal are worth exploring? Introduce them based on the public material and cite sources.

guide.title: Find answers faster
guide.description: Ask directly instead of browsing page by page
guide.prompt: I'm new to this personal portal. How can I quickly find the information that interests me? Please give practical suggestions.

sources.title: Check the sources
sources.description: See how citations lead back to the original material
sources.prompt: How are sources cited in answers, and how can I verify an answer and its evidence?

Service.referenceCount: {count, plural, one {# public source} other {# public sources}}

Composer.label: Message input
Composer.offline: You’re offline. Reconnect before sending or retrying.
Composer.generationFailed: The answer could not be generated. Please try again later.
Composer.storageWarning: Browser storage is unavailable or full. This conversation still works, but it may be lost after a refresh.
Composer.placeholder: Ask me anything about this portal…
Composer.stopAnnouncement: Generation stopped. The content shown may be incomplete.
Composer.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Verify important information and sources.

Announcement.retrieving: Searching the portal’s public material and generating an answer.
Announcement.sendFailed: Could not send. Check your connection and try again.
Announcement.completed: Answer complete. You can view its sources or ask another question.
Announcement.failed: The answer failed. Your current content is preserved; you can retry.
Announcement.retrying: Regenerating the answer; the previous content is preserved.
Announcement.retryFailed: Could not send the retry. Please try again later.

Announcement.cleared: The conversation in this browser has been cleared.

Sources.title: Answer evidence
Sources.description: These are excerpts from the public material retrieved for this answer. Check the original text; a citation does not guarantee that a conclusion is correct.

PrivacyDialog.title: Privacy and usage boundaries
PrivacyDialog.history: Conversation history is stored only in this browser and can be cleared from the page.
PrivacyDialog.model: New questions and necessary context are sent to the server and then to the configured model service.
PrivacyDialog.sensitive: Do not enter sensitive information such as passwords, ID numbers, or contact details.
PrivacyDialog.references: Answers are grounded in public material. If there is not enough evidence, the assistant says so instead of guessing.
